promo.label: naive descriptive difference, NOT a promotion effect

outliers.robust_z_definition: (log(sales) - store median of log(sales)) / (1.4826 * store MAD of log(sales))

seasonality.index_definition: sales / store mean over its open positive-sales days in scope
seasonality.daily_series_rule: days with fewer than half of the stores open are excluded (NaN), not interpolated
